concepts.label: Infant photograph eye closure
concepts.definition: Acceptability of partially or completely closed eyes in an infant photograph.
concepts.quote: It is acceptable if the infant's eyes, particularly a newborn's, are partially or completely closed;

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to photographs of infants, where infants pose a particular challenge and the goal is the best likeness that can reasonably be obtained.
unit_attributes.object_quote: the infant's eyes, particularly a newborn's
unit_attributes.object: the infant's eyes, particularly a newborn's
unit_attributes.statement: In photographs of infants, it is acceptable if the infant's eyes, particularly a newborn's, are partially or completely closed.

concepts.label: Infant head support
concepts.definition: Permissibility of discreetly supporting an infant's head in a photograph.
concepts.quote: The infant's head may be discreetly supported, e.g., a car seat with a white or off-white blanket behind the child.

unit_attributes.statement: The infant's head may be discreetly supported, such as with a car seat with a white or off-white blanket behind the child.

concepts.label: Infant head tilt
concepts.definition: Acceptability of head tilt in infant photographs.
concepts.quote: Head tilt is acceptable for infants

unit_attributes.statement: Head tilt is acceptable for infants in photographs.

concepts.label: Parent face in infant photograph
concepts.definition: Prohibition of a parent's face appearing in an infant's photograph.
concepts.quote: A parent’s face cannot be in the photograph of the infant.

unit_attributes.statement: A parent’s face cannot be in the photograph of the infant.

concepts.label: Requesting a new photograph
concepts.definition: Obligation to request a replacement photograph if requirements are not met.
concepts.quote: You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements:

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies when the photograph submitted does not meet the specified requirements.
unit_attributes.logic_text: if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements

qualifications.statement: If the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements.

unit_attributes.statement: You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the specified requirements.

concepts.label: Color photograph requirement
concepts.definition: Requirement that a submitted photograph must be in color.
concepts.quote: (1) The photograph must be in color;

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to submitted photographs subject to requirements.
unit_attributes.statement: The photograph must be in color.

concepts.label: Photograph timeliness and likeness standards
concepts.definition: Standards concerning the timing of the photograph and its depiction and identification of the applicant.
concepts.quote: The photograph should be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application

typed_values.name: photo_recency_window
typed_values.quote: within six months of submitting the application

unit_attributes.logic_text: within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application
unit_attributes.action_quote: be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application
unit_attributes.action: be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application
unit_attributes.statement: The photograph should be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application (see 22 CFR 51.26).

concepts.label: Appearance changes in photograph
concepts.definition: Acceptability of hairstyle or facial hair changes between the photograph and submitted identification.
concepts.quote: A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted is acceptable if it still is a good likeness of the applicant;

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to a photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted, provided that it still is a good likeness of the applicant.
unit_attributes.logic_text: if it still is a good likeness of the applicant
unit_attributes.object_quote: A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted
unit_attributes.object: A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted

qualifications.statement: It still is a good likeness of the applicant.

unit_attributes.statement: A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted is acceptable if it still is a good likeness of the applicant.

concepts.label: Re-use of certificate photograph
concepts.definition: Descriptive possibility of applicants wishing to re-use a photograph from a citizenship or naturalization certificate.
concepts.quote: Applicants may wish to re-use a passport photograph that is depicted on their submitted U.S Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to applicants submitting a U.S. Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization.
unit_attributes.object_quote: a passport photograph that is depicted on their submitted U.S Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization
unit_attributes.object: a passport photograph that is depicted on their submitted U.S Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization
unit_attributes.statement: Applicants may wish to re-use a passport photograph that is depicted on their submitted U.S Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization.

concepts.label: Recency risk of certificate photograph
concepts.definition: Potential that a certificate photograph was not taken within six months of application submission due to USCIS processing times.
concepts.quote: even if the certificate itself was recently issued, because of U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services processing times, the photograph may not have been taken within six months of submitting the application.
